purpose: Independent extension of the existing simulated AIS study. Freeze before generating new results; preserve all original experiments.

geometry.random_base_origin: Uniform [0,h)^2 independently by width and paired sample; reused across origin counts and both periods.

statistics: All method comparisons paired on identical point clouds. Test rates use one-sided Clopper-Pearson bounds with tail 0.05/3 across three widths within each density condition, method, distance and side; no simultaneous claim across the complete experiment matrix. Bootstrap mean-error intervals are descriptive pointwise 95% intervals. Geometry and structure are exploratory stress tests with pointwise 95% intervals.
density_thresholds: Compare the original frozen thresholds with independent density-specific calibration: for each N, hotspot fraction and method, take the maximum 96th-percentile order statistic over widths 1.2 and 2.0. Do not calibrate using test data or width 1.6.
structure_truth: Both components translate by the same vector in stable double-hotspot scenarios. In weight_switch both component centers remain stationary while weights change: report an activity-redistribution response, not a false-positive rate for an unchanged density field; vector error is undefined.
timing: 30 independently generated clouds at each N=200,800,3200; wall time for standalone single-, four-, nine-, sixteen-grid median estimators, h=2; randomized order and warmup; median and IQR; no end-to-end I/O or plotting. Same bincount implementation for all timing methods.
scope: Synthetic report positions only; no vessel identifiers, trajectories, fishing labels, real AIS, or real-world accuracy claim. All added seeds are separated by family/cohort and from previous seeds. Shared initial samples across distances are accounted for by separate per-distance analyses.
